newsitem.title: USA: Western Resources, Protection One in pact.
newsitem.headline: Western Resources, Protection One in pact.

text.p: Western Resources Inc and Protection One Inc said Wednesday they would combine their security services businesses in a deal that will result in Western Resources owning 80.1 percent of Protection One's shares.
The combined security services businesses will be a $1 billion company that will rank No. 2 in the industry in the U.S., the companies said.
Western Resources will contribute its security operations and $320 million in exchange for 80.1 percent of Protection One's shares, they said.
Protection One shareholders of record at the closing date will receive a special dividend of $7 a share and will continue to own a 19.9 percent stake in the company.
Protection One said it expects to make a conversion price adjustment on the 6-3/4 percent convertible senior subordinated notes related to the special dividend.
The companies said they expect to complete the deal this fall.
The combined entity will be called Protection One.

James Mackenzie Jr, chief executive and president of Protection One, will head the new company. It will be headquartered in Culver City, Calif., and Irving, Texas. Its shares will continue to trade on Nasdaq under the symbol ALRM.
